# Third-party source

`sqlite-unpack/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100` is the official SQLite 3.54.1 amalgamation downloaded from <https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip>. SQLite is dedicated to the public domain. The downloaded ZIP SHA-256 was `0A9C8E34352DAD46006AA82836D5383BFF9DC6BC9CE5A60553C05AA30E6AD1F9` (the official page publishes SHA3-256, a different algorithm).
